As Intl Business Machines (IBM) Share Value Declined, Quinn Opportunity Partners Raised Its Stake by $2.14 Million; Jacobson & Schmitt Advisors Holds Stake in Acuity Brands (AYI)
April 27, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Jacobson & Schmitt Advisors Llc increased its stake in Acuity Brands Inc (AYI) by 79.32% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jacobson & Schmitt Advisors Llc bought 13,179 shares as the company’s stock declined 21.04% with the market. The institutional investor held 29,794 shares of the building products company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.24 million, up from 16,615 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jacobson & Schmitt Advisors Llc who had been investing in Acuity Brands Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.12 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.96% or $2.52 during the last trading session, reaching $126.3. About 755,079 shares traded or 7.05% up from the average. Acuity Brands, Inc. (NYSE:AYI) has declined 31.54% since April 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 43.09% the S&P500.
Quinn Opportunity Partners Llc increased its stake in Intl Business Machines Corp (IBM) by 89.17% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Quinn Opportunity Partners Llc bought 14,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.39% with the market. The institutional investor held 29,700 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.56M, up from 15,700 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Quinn Opportunity Partners Llc who had been investing in Intl Business Machines Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $135.58 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.31% or $0.46 during the last trading session, reaching $147.18. About 113,838 shares traded. International Business Machines Corporation (NYSE:IBM) has declined 12.58% since April 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.13% the S&P500.
